'''Samantha Cooper''' is a voice actress for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with CESD Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Cooper is an American voice actress currently living in New York. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced [[Ash's Meltan]] and the {{p|Meltan}} species as a whole.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===

* {{p|Meltan}} ({{OBP|Meltan|recurring|anime}})

* Jacquelyn (''Dates Like This'')
* Lisa (''The Killing of Jacob Marr'')
